account: Today I have mainly heard ordinary market news rather than evidence of anything improper. Several townsfolk reported the baker carrying wheat at the bakery this morning, then a sack of bread at the inn around one and at plaza_north_1 later. That could simply be baking and deliveries or sales; I have not witnessed the transactions or learned their purpose. The repeated reports do not establish a secret undertaking. Freight has appeared near town hall holding an emerald, but I could not make out what freight said. The innkeeper is now near the market holding an emerald too; I do not know whether these observations are connected. The secretary says no unusual news or specific repair requests have reached them. The builder reports a passable bridge, lanterns present, and no confirmed defects or recommended repairs. The builder has repeatedly requested approval for a two-emerald inspection fee despite no advance agreement; I declined retrospective approval. This is an unresolved administrative conversation, not evidence of a wider scheme. I still feel I should learn more about town business, but I have no reliable basis for accusing anyone. My next scheduled appointment is three o'clock tea at the dockside cottage, followed by office at half past four.
